notes:
お{金|かね} means money. The ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧ is a polite prefix (can also say {金|かね} in casual speech).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay money
- お{金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to borrow money
- お{金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→溜める：02068_tameru⟧: to save money
- お{金|かね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not enough money
- お{金|かね}がかかる: to cost money

COMPOUNDS:
- お{金持|かねも}ち: rich person
- {小遣|こづか}い: pocket money, allowance
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: cash
